vendor_kadai_tip.label: Kicked stand skids and the kadai rocks over: a long metal scrape and creak, a low knock at the tip

vendor_ghee_spill.label: The kadai goes over: iron crash, a rush of ghee and the fire catching with a whoosh

vendor_exhale.label: Out cold: his last long breath out

cond_coin_tick.label: Single quiet clink for meter transfer; 105 ms

cond_box_drop.label: Metal cash box landing, body thud with brief steel resonance

cond_swing.label: Lower broad whoosh leading the heavy box contact
